exception_policy.timing: Only enumerated timing leaves may differ; they must remain finite nonnegative numbers and may not be removed.
exception_policy.environment: Library/Python versions are recorded and may differ. Keys are fixed and native_threads must be exactly1.
exception_policy.protocol_sha256: Actual result must bind the exact current public protocol; historical result binds original historical protocol. Both identities are checked separately.
exception_policy.source_hashes: Exact runtime source identities and every public protocol source are checked separately; this is not a free metadata exception.
exception_policy.started_utc_completed_utc: UTC instants may differ; both are required and chronological.

comparison: Exact type, ordered structure and value equality for every remaining field. No score tolerance implies optimizer equivalence.
scope: NZ observed frozen three-fold fitted procedure. Previously inspected retrospective data; no new confirmatory or physical inference.
